date_issues.note: Ashyq CSV has no DT_BEG/DT_END; date checks not applicable.

icd_issues.note: ICD codes come from egov illnesses layer, audited separately in SQL/EDA.

synthetic_check.note: Ashyq clinical CSV only (Age, Gender, BMI, lifestyle/clinical factors, Diagnosis). No fabricated patient cards, ICD codes, regions, or observation dates. Regional ICD volume uses real egov illnesses open data. Dataset size (~1700 rows) is below the recommended 500k guideline; instructor agreed to keep real medical data without synthesis.

data_policy: No synthetic medical registry fields (fake NOMKART/ICD/region/dates). Analysis uses Ashyq clinical CSV + real egov illnesses aggregates.
